hours_text: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM, Sunday: closed.

intents.name: greeting
responses: Hello! Welcome to TechNest support. How can I help you?
Hi there! Ask me about our products, prices, shipping, returns or opening hours.

intents.name: hours
intents.details: You can also reach us by email at any time and we will reply within one working day.

intents.name: products
responses: We sell laptops, smartphones, headphones, smartwatches and accessories such as chargers and cases.
intents.details: Every product ships with a manufacturer warranty. Ask me about pricing or warranty for more.

intents.name: pricing
responses: Accessories start at Rs. 299, headphones at Rs. 1,499, smartphones at Rs. 9,999 and laptops at Rs. 34,999.
intents.details: We run discounts during festival sales. Subscribe to our newsletter to hear about them first.

intents.name: shipping
responses: Standard delivery takes 3-5 working days and is free on orders above Rs. 999.
intents.details: Express delivery (1-2 working days) is available for Rs. 149 in major cities.

intents.name: returns
responses: You can return any product within 7 days of delivery if it is unused and in its original packaging.
intents.details: Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5-7 working days after we receive the item.

intents.name: warranty
responses: All products include a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Keep your invoice as proof of purchase.
intents.details: Accidental damage is not covered by the standard warranty.

intents.name: payment
responses: We accept UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking and cash on delivery. EMI is available on orders above Rs. 5,000.
intents.details: All online payments are processed through secure payment gateways.

intents.name: order_status
responses: You can track your order from the 'My Orders' page using the tracking link sent to your email.
intents.details: If the link is not working, share your order number with our support team.

intents.name: contact
responses: You can email support@technest.example or call 1800-000-000 during business hours.

intents.name: help
responses: I can answer questions about: business hours, products, prices, shipping, returns, warranty, payments, order tracking and contact details. Type 'bye' to exit.

intents.name: name
responses: I'm PyBot, the TechNest virtual support assistant.
